title: Unnamed Orphan 003
summary: A unnamed orphan with brown hair lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Growing up at Rotterdam Orphanage, this orphan would regularly bully Harrison Fears with the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, he and the other orphans began training for them. [Den vs Harrison]

This orphan was eventually enrolled into Tantras' class of students and was sent to eliminate Den for betraying the Blood Spiral. He attacked Sophie Casterwill and fought with Lok who pursued him into a warehouse. He attempted to attack Lok by surprise but was defeated by Powerbonded Lindorm. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext: Like the other orphans, this orphan was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. {{source|Den vs Harrison}} He seemed to favor surprise attacks and hiding behind walls and objects while fighting his targets. {{source|Boys Will Be Seekers}}

full_text:
A unnamed orphan with brown hair lived at the Rotterdam Orphanage with Den and Harrison Fears. He was recruited by Tantras and joined the Blood Spiral as one of his students.

History

Growing up at Rotterdam Orphanage, this orphan would regularly bully Harrison Fears with the other orphans, which often resulted in fights with Den Fears, who fought to protect his little brother and the other weaker kids at the orphanage. [Den vs Harrison]

When Tantras and the Blood Spiral came to the orphanage in search of recruits, he and the other orphans began training for them. [Den vs Harrison]

This orphan was eventually enrolled into Tantras' class of students and was sent to eliminate Den for betraying the Blood Spiral. He attacked Sophie Casterwill and fought with Lok who pursued him into a warehouse. He attempted to attack Lok by surprise but was defeated by Powerbonded Lindorm. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Personality

Like the other orphans, this orphan was a cowardly bully who constantly tormented Harrison at any opportunity. [Den vs Harrison] He seemed to favor surprise attacks and hiding behind walls and objects while fighting his targets. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Abilities

This orphan was a thug who picked on those weaker than him. [Den vs Harrison] However, after training with the Blood Spiral, he developed a grasp of the standard Blood Spiral powers and became a lot stronger. [Boys Will Be Seekers]

Spells Utilized

• Augerfrost
• Cutrace
• Nullcurse
• Raypulse
